caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object, rendered in shades of gray on a plain, light background. The object appears to be constructed from iron and consists of a vertical bar with a rounded ball at the top, which arches into a curved hook-like shape. From the base of the vertical bar, two legs extend downward and outward, each leg ending in a small curled foot, giving the object a tripod-like appearance. Another bar projects horizontally from the main body at a right angle, supported by an angular brace. The background is unadorned, leaving the focus solely on the central object. The paper shows slight discoloration at the edges, mostly near the upper right corner. There is a faint signature in the lower right corner.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
